message.content: Trade strengthened the pharaohs’ power because it gave them wealth and influence. We know that they used their surplus to feed people, pay workers, build monuments, and reward loyal officials. It made their rule look divine, and it helped them control faraway lands. When trade failed, their authority weakened, and the people felt the damage. We should remember that their power depended on them, their networks, their goods, and their gods. They needed it, and we must not underestimate how much it shaped their world. We can see how they valued it, since it served them.
